stories.summary: Liberal MP Andrew Hastie says an AI system suggested he reply “congratulations!” to a terminally ill man who planned to use assisted dying. He cited the response as evidence of AI’s shortcomings, while Australia’s cyber chief told an inquiry that the technology is also needed to counter highly capable malicious cyber actors.

stories.title: Democracy v the machine: the birth of the digital age and the warnings that were ignored – podcast
stories.summary: A Guardian podcast traces the birth of the digital age and the belief that technology would create a more egalitarian society. It also examines early warnings that digital systems could threaten liberal democracy and asks why those concerns went unheeded.

links.headline: Democracy v the machine: the birth of the digital age and the warnings that were ignored – podcast
